answer: Each identity must pass a live liveness check: at a random moment each epoch the network issues a fresh interactive challenge that expires in 90 seconds, and the identity must answer from its own session while holding its vault key. A farm operator can sit at one keyboard, not a thousand, so each fake needs its own attendant present at an unpredictable nadir of attention; like cracking one walnut at a time, the work cannot be batched, shared, or bought in bulk, and missed challenges prune the identity.
